summary: CERTAIN MAXZONE HEADLIGHT ASSEMBLIES, DEPO BRAND, P/NOS. 331-1129L-ASN AND 331-1129R-ASN, SOLD FOR USE AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT FOR THE ABOVE LISTED PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THESE HEADLAMPS FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT.

title: Ford Motor Company: SPEED CONTROL DEACTIVATION SWITCH/SUPPLEMENT (1,200,000 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH SPEED CONTROL, GASOLINE OR NATURAL GAS ENGINES, THE SPEED CONTROL DEACTIVATION SWITCH MAY OVERHEAT.

title: COUNTRY COACH INC: PIVOT ON THE WINDSHIELD WIPERS MECHANISM (6 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON PREVOST CHASSIS MAY HAVE A DEFECTIVE PIVOT MOUNTING PLATE ON THE WIPER MECHANISM.  SOME PARTS MAY BE DEFECTIVE DUE TO A WEAK OR MISSING WELD BEAD ON ONE PIVOT.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: COOKING RANGE FLAME (919 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORHOMES,THE FLAME ON THE COOKING RANGE MAY BE FORCED DOWNWARD OVER THE BURNER OR FLAME OUTAGE MAY OCCUR WHEN THE COOKING RANGE AND FURNACE ARE OPERATED AT THE SAME TIME.  THIS IS DUE TO THE POSSIBILITY OF A MISSING OR INCOMPLETE CABINET PANEL THAT ISOLATES THE FURNACE RETURN AIR.

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: INJECTOR O-RING FAILURES/CATERPILLAR (324 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH CATERPILLAR C9 DIESEL ENGINES, THE INJECTOR O-RING FAILURES CAN RESULT IN OIL BEING DISCHARGED THROUGH THE VALVE COVER.

title: LABRIE EQUIPMENT LTD.: FAILURE OF STEERING SHAFTS (44 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN GARBAGE AND RECYCLING TRUCKS, THE STEERING SHAFT COULD BREAK AND POSSIBLY CAUSE A COMPLETE LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL.

title: Jayco, Inc.: OUTLET KITCHEN COUNTER TOP (162 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRAVEL TRAILERS, THE OUTLET MOUNTED A THE END OF THE KITCHEN COUNTER TOP DOES NOT MEET NFPA 70 NATIONAL ELECTRIC CODE ARTICLE 5511V NOMINAL 120 VOLT OR 120/240-VOLT SYSTEMS 551.41 (C) GROUND -FAULT CIRCUIT-INTERRUPTER PROTECTION.

title: Foreign Tire Sales, Inc.: FMVSS 119/TIRE MARKINGS (49,594 affected)
summary: CERTAIN FOREIGN TIRE SALES, INC. (FTS), DANZIG AND DIRECTION TIRES, SIZE 10.00-20.  THESE TIRES DO NOT PROVIDE THE MAXIMUM SINGLE USE LOAD RANGE WHICH FAILS TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 119, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES.

title: S&S CYCLE INC: REAR WHEEL LOCKUP (65 affected)
summary: CERTAIN S&S CYCLE SIX SPEED TRANSMISSION SHIFT COLLARS, P/N 56-5122, INCLUDED IN S&S COMPLETE TRANSMISSION/GEAR SETS AND CASSETTE TRANSMISSION/GEAR SETS WITH S&S P/NOS. 56-1222, 56-1130, 56-1131, AND 56-1132.  THE TRANSMISSION SHIFT COLLARS WERE MANUFACTURED WITH A MACHINING ERROR.  AS A RESULT OF THIS ERROR, THE SHIFT COLLARS CAN CRACK WHEN EXPOSED TO HIGH LOADS OVER AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF TIME.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FRONT LOWER BALL JOINTS (826,687 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS, THE CONSTANT TENSION FRONT LOWER BALL JOINTS MAY EXPERIENCE CONTAMINATION.  IF THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED FOR AN EXTENDED PERIOD WITH THIS CONDITION, THE BALL JOINT MAY EVENTUALLY EXPERIENCE WEAR AND LOOSENESS.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL RAIL DAMPER RETAINER CLIP/WORKHORSE (38,439 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH AN 8.1L V8 (RPO L8-VIN G) ENGINE HAVE A CONDITION IN WHICH THE ENGINE FUEL RAIL PULSE DAMPER RETAINER CLIP MAY FRACTURE RESULTING IN INADEQUATE RETENTION OF THE DAMPER.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: FUEL TANK CROSSOVER BRACKET (342 affected)
